subject: Implementation handoff: compliance feature Qs — audit policy, retention windows, and BYOK path
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@healthsync.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on audit logs/retention and BYOK path for production rollout

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Security team had a few follow-ups before we sign the change request for production:

- Can you confirm the granularity of the audit logs (user id, request id, full request/response or redacted tokens)?
- What configurable retention windows do you support out of the box and how do we request an exception?
- For BYOK/KMS: what is the supported key lifecycle and rotation model — can we use our own HSM-backed keys and audit key usage logs?

I've attached HealthSync's compliance questionnaire and a short list of must-have evidence. We need a concise summary we can share with our Compliance Ops by EOD Friday if possible.

Appreciate any quick wins you can surface.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Security Engineering, HealthSync

Redwood Inference

Attachments: HealthSync_audit_requirements_2026.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Questions on audit logs/retention and BYOK path for production rollout

Lauren / team — quick technical summary on audit logs:

What we can provide today (hosted):
- Event-level logs with timestamps, internal request_id, customer_id, model_id, route, and basic status codes.
- For privacy we redact prompt tokens by default; however, we can provide request/response payloads into a secure evidence bucket on a per-account basis for customers with approved NDA and retention policy (HealthSync would have to sign an evidence access addendum).
- KV cache and ephemeral tokens are never logged.

Configurable retention:
- Default: 90 days (logs + metrics).
- Extended tiers: 1 year / 3 years available via Dedicated contracts (requires reserved capacity).
- Exception path: submit INF ticket -> Product review -> Legal sign-off -> Ops provisioning. Typical turnaround 7–14 business days if no infra changes.

Audit schema notes:
- Attached is audit_schema_v2.csv with proposed field list and examples.
- We should avoid including PII fields; if HealthSync needs more granular payloads we must document redaction rules in the addendum.

Open question for Neha: for BYOK, what level of key usage telemetry do we record in audit logs vs KMS vendor logs? We should map fields.

I can draft the one-pager based on this and the attachment if people confirm the exception path language.

-Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime

Attachments: audit_schema_v2.csv
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Questions on audit logs/retention and BYOK path for production rollout

Team — BYOK/KMS notes:

- Supported flows: customer-managed keys in AWS KMS (customer grants Redwood decrypt/encrypt role), CloudHSM-backed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments, and a Hosted-signed key escrow flow for short-term evaluation.
- Key rotation: we can support scheduled rotation; for CloudHSM we recommend annual rotation and will surface rotation events to both customer and Redwood audit channels.
- Key usage evidence: KMS vendor logs (e.g., CloudTrail) should be the source of truth for cryptographic operations. We can ingest/normalize those events into the customer's audit bundle when configured (requires a one-time connector setup).

Constraints & infra impact:
- Evidence ingestion requires a small connector service and additional S3 retention for normalized events (estimate +0.2 TB/month for HealthSync volume).
- Timeline: connector + normalization + sample evidence export = 3–4 weeks for Dedicated; 4–6 weeks for Hosted with security review and addendum.

I'll work with Karthik on the exception process steps and draft the KMS mapping they need for Compliance.

-Neha
Security & Compliance PM

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@healthsync.io>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on audit logs/retention and BYOK path for production rollout — summary and next steps

Alyssa — thanks for the patience and the detail you shared. Below is the summary we will deliver to Compliance Ops and the timeline for the delivery package.

Summary (high level):
- Audit logs: we can provide event-level logs (timestamps, request_id, customer_id, model_id, route, status). Request/response payloads are available by exception into a secure evidence bucket (requires addendum).
- Retention: default 90 days; Extended (1yr/3yr) available under Dedicated/reserved capacity. Exceptions processed via INF ticket + Product/Legal review (7–14 business days typical).
- BYOK/KMS: support for AWS KMS + CloudHSM (Dedicated/Private). Key usage evidence is sourced from vendor logs (CloudTrail) and can be ingested/normalized into the audit bundle with a connector.

Deliverables & timelines:
- One-page compliance summary (Marcus) — draft by Thu EOD (tomorrow).
- KMS mapping doc + connector impact estimate (Neha & Karthik) — initial draft by next Wed.
- Exception process flow and template (Karthik) — draft by next Tue.
- Evidence packet for HealthSync (incl. sample normalized log export) — targeted delivery in 3 weeks pending review.

Action items for HealthSync: please confirm whether you need full request/response payloads into the evidence bucket or if redacted payloads (token-level redaction) suffice — that determines the approval path.

If anything in the above timeline is unrealistic from your side, flag which item and we'll reprioritize.

Regards,
Lauren
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BYOK_integration_matrix.xlsx
